name: structSome
description: This function calls a closure/function on every element in a struct until one returns true.
syntax: structSome( struct struct, function closure, [boolean parallel], [number maxThreads] )

params.name: closure
params.description:
function/closure that implements the following constructor

`function(key, value, st){}`

and returns a boolean value

params.name: maxThreads
params.description: maximum number of threads executed, ignored when argument "parallel" is set to false
